function.description: Validate a JSON-lines file (read-only): line count, valid count, first bad lines, and duplicate values of <key> if given.
function.name: filesystem_jsonl_validate

parameters.description:
056 WS2: read-only — line count, valid count, first bad lines, and (with
`key`) duplicate values of that field.

key.description: Optional field to check for duplicates, e.g. 'id'.
